thread:
incident-bot: AUTO-PAGE: High 5xx error-rate spike detected for inference-gateway (eu-west1) - alert burn: 120s. PD: https://pd.example/PD12345 :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: Incident created: PD12345 - Priority: P1. Escalation policy: inference-oncall.
Devon: acked on PD, taking first look. ETA 2m.
Sasha: noted huge ramp in 502/503s from edge -> gateway, spike correlates w/ peak traffic. seeing 20% 5xx on front-tier.
Maya: thanks Devon. can you check recent deploys to inference-gateway? `git rev-parse --short HEAD` + last deploy id.
Devon: no new deploys in the last 30m. last deploy: d3f4c9 (2h ago).
Samir: looking at LB metrics — connection resets and backend 504s from pool-a. CPU on gateway pods normal, but appear to be saturating on accept queue.
InfraSRE: running `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide` now, sharing pod list.
Devon: pod logs show repeated error: `http2: stream closed` and `failed to forward request: cancelled while reading body` — looks like backend pool eviction.
Sasha: could be kvcache eviction cascade or upstream worker restart. checking kv cache eviction metrics and redis TTLs.
Maya: quick customer check — @support, any new customer tickets? need to proactively notify if broad impact.
OncallRotation: support: a couple of error reports from high-volume customers, some request retries causing timeouts. Severity: degraded for a subset of requests.
Devon: mitigation plan: 1) route a small percentage -> fallback model variant in another region, 2) scale up gateway replicas, 3) if needed, rollback route-change that added new perf path. I'll try (2) first.
Sasha: +1 for scale. also enable prefix cache warmup for the hot model to reduce backend load.
Samir: scaling now: `kubectl scale deployment inference-gateway --replicas=8 -n inference` — started.
incident-bot: Deploy scaling event recorded: deployment/inference-gateway scaled to 8 replicas by Samir.
Devon: after scale, 5xx rate dipped from 18% -> 8% in ~45s. still above baseline (~0.5%).
Maya: start gradual traffic steering to eu-west-fallback: add 10% to fallback route. command: `curl -X POST https://console/route -d '{"route":"eu-west-fallback","percent":10}'`
Samir: route change applied, verifying.
pagerduty-bot: PD12345: on-call acknowledged by Devon. Note added: "Scaling + partial traffic reroute applied."
Sasha: checking kv cache — eviction rate spiked at 14:37 UTC, correlates with error burst. background job restarted across workers at ~14:35, possibly regressing cache warm state.
Devon: rolling restart of worker pool to re-warm caches? risk of short-term increased errors. prefer warming in new nodes then cutover.
Maya: agree avoid mass restart. continue scale + reroute + cache warming. notify customers via status page if degradation persists.
OncallRotation: posting interim status to customers: "We are investigating increased error rates for inference requests in eu-west1. Mitigations under way — scaling + rerouting. No data loss reported."
Samir: metrics update: 5xx now ~2.3% after scale + 10% reroute. latency back to normal for routed traffic.
Devon: I'll keep PD updated and monitor for 15m. If error <1% for 10m, we'll move to recovery steps.
incident-bot: Note: automated alert suppression engaged for noisy signals from the same PD after manual mitigation.
Sasha: found root cause candidate: a recent background GC spike in model-worker causing increased tail latency -> upstream timeout. GC event at 14:34 triggered retries and kv churn.
Maya: file an action item: add GC jitter and lower memory churn threshold in model-worker. assign to Sasha.
Devon: PD status updated: Mitigation in progress. Reduced customer impact via partial reroute.
Samir: continuing to warm additional nodes, pushing warmer prefix cache.
Sasha: added a temporary guard in the gateway to increase upstream timeout from 30s -> 45s for high-memory models; will monitor.
Devon: 5xx drifted down to 0.6% over the last 8m. Good sign.
OncallRotation: customers: green-check with major customers who reported. no ongoing escalations.
Maya: moving to recovery: start gradual rollback of traffic steering after 20m stable at <1% 5xx.
Samir: rollback step: reduce fallback percent to 0 after confirming warm caches on primary.
Devon: last check: error-rate steady at 0.3% for 12m. marking incident as mitigated. PD12345: resolved (mitigation: scale + partial reroute + cache warm + gateway timeout guard).
pagerduty-bot: PD12345: Resolved by Devon. Please file a postmortem if root cause confirmed.
Maya: filing a short RCA ticket: "GC-induced cache churn -> upstream timeouts -> 5xx spike". Sasha + Samir assigned. follow-up: add GC tuning, cache warm strategy, alert tuning to reduce noisy autopaging.
Devon: quick notes for follow-up runbook edits: - add step to verify background job restarts during peak, - prefer scale + reroute vs full worker restart, - add automated cache-warm action when worker restarts.
incident-bot: Incident thread closed for PD12345. Please continue any long-form follow-up in #postmortems with link to PD12345. :white_check_mark:
